item.title: Catalogue of the reptiles (Reptilia) of Bolivia: checklist, distribution and literature
item.description: Bolivia is biogeographically diverse and consequently has a rich herpetofauna. We present an updated list of reptiles from Bolivia, consisting of a total of 314 species, belonging to 118 genera and 28 families. For each taxon we include comments, conservation status, new records, distribution maps and photographs (of 65% of the species).
